THE PRODUCT· CHECKED AGAINST V1.0.0-RC.98 ON 2026-10-23

SEARCH FOR
AI AGENTS.

A new way for AI to search for data: one local Rust binary that indexes your code, docs, specs and logs, plus Corpus Hub packs, and returns cited answers. The binary is Apache-2.0. It answers with file:line citations and serves them through a CLI, an MCP server and the Elasticsearch API, so an agent reads a passage instead of a whole file.

01 WHO IT IS FOR 02 QUICKSTART 03 WHAT SHIPS 04 CORPUS HUB 05 MEASURED 06 HOW IT COMPARES 07 FIELD REPORTS 08 FAQ
01·WHO IT IS FOR

THREE KINDS
OF USER.

Coding agents
Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client that needs code it has not memorised. xerj init writes the MCP config and the skill files for the agent directories it finds, and keeps a .bak of any file it edits.
A folder of data
JSONL, CSV, PDFs, HTML, SQLite, an advisory dump. xerj autoindex <folder> sniffs each file by content. xerj autoindex map prints what landed. xerj autoindex remove --prefix <name> drops that folder after printing a plan.
Elasticsearch clients
The node speaks the Elasticsearch REST API on :9200. The conformance suite passes 1,444 / 1,454 cases (0 failed, 10 skipped) (README.md).

Not a fit, today: neural semantic search with no extra flag (the default embedder is lexical feature hashing; --embed-mode neural loads an all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model, about 90 MB, at startup), regex search over source (the benchmarks page marks it “not offered”), or a machine where an idle daemon must cost nothing (8% CPU and 8.3 GB on a 15-repo corpus, a published loss).

02·QUICKSTART

INSTALL, INDEX,
ASK.

The installer at xerj.org/get picks the release for your OS and CPU, checks its SHA-256, and puts xerj on ~/.local/bin (xerj.exe there under Git Bash, MSYS or Cygwin). PowerShell's installer (get.ps1) puts xerj.exe in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\xerj instead. On Linux the default archive is the static musl build. xerj --version on that binary, run 2026-10-23, printed xerj v1.0.0-rc.98.

curl -fsSL https://xerj.org/get | sh
xerj --insecure --data-dir ~/xerj-data &          # node on 127.0.0.1:9200
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/psf/requests ref/requests
xerj autoindex ref/requests --prefix req
xerj search --prefix req -k 3 "rebuild auth on redirect strip authorization"
xerj def --prefix req should_strip_auth

--insecure turns off TLS and API-key auth. It is for one user on a dev machine. The default bind is 127.0.0.1. Without the flag, clients send the key the node writes to <data-dir>/admin.key.

No clone: ask a hub corpus

xerj "<question>" is the same command as xerj ask. It routes the question to a corpus in the signed catalogue, starts a local node when nothing answers on port 9200, pulls that corpus’s pack once, and names the corpus, the pin and the licence. This is the rc.98 binary on 2026-10-23, scratch home, feedback disabled. Stderr first, then the first hit. The rest of stdout is trimmed.

$ xerj "how does lz4 find a match"

03·WHAT SHIPS IN THE BINARY

ONE BINARY.
ONE CLI.

The rows below are the commands xerj --help printed on v1.0.0-rc.98, plus xerj hub --help. On that binary the top-level usage block lists xerj ask and does not list xerj hub. v1.0.0-rc.99 lists xerj hub next to xerj ask when the build has a hub signing key (#2282). xerj hub --help is the subcommand help.

CommandWhat it does
xerj --insecure --data-dir DIRStarts the node. Elasticsearch-compatible API on 9200, native REST on 8080, gRPC on 8081. --port N moves the three to N, N+1 and N+2.
xerj autoindex<folder> discovers and indexes a folder or an s3:// / r2:// prefix. map prints the data map. remove --prefix <P> drops one autoindexed folder after a plan.
xerj search · xerj defRanked passages with path:line, and go-to-definition. Lexical by default: they match the words you typed.
xerj "<question>" · xerj askAnswers from a hub corpus. --def SYMBOL, --how, --files, --offline, --json, --hosted on|off|auto. Exit 1 when nothing matches.
xerj code · xerj corpuscorpus add|index|list pins and builds corpora you choose. code <corpus> "<query>" retrieves a definition and warns on the licence.
xerj hubsync, pull, feedback, status, stop, and config hosted on|off|auto. Packs are verified, then restored. They are not cloned or indexed on your machine.
xerj mcpxerj mcp --help on this binary says it proxies 20 tools, and tools/list returned those 20. Main adds xerj_def and xerj_batch_search, for 22 (mcp-tools.json). The hub three are xerj_hub_find, xerj_hub_def, xerj_hub_ask. It does not start a node.
xerj initWrites .mcp.json, and, when the directory exists, .cursor/mcp.json, .codex/config.toml, the skill and rule files, and an AGENTS.md section.
xerj brain · xerj share · xerj gain · xerj feedbackA browsable second brain, a read-only link with a passcode and an expiry, usage counted from the audit log, and the field report in section 07.

The 20 names from that tools/list: xerj_search, xerj_semantic_search, xerj_vector_search, xerj_hybrid_search, xerj_memory_store, xerj_memory_recall, xerj_brain_ego, xerj_brain_link, xerj_brain_unlink, xerj_brain_overview, xerj_map, xerj_index_budget, xerj_autoindex_remove, xerj_code_search, xerj_plan, xerj_field_report, xerj_corpus_feedback, xerj_hub_find, xerj_hub_def, xerj_hub_ask. The schema on main after the rc.98 tag adds xerj_def and lists 21 (mcp-tools.json). That tool is not in the rc.98 binary. The agent surface is also on For agents and in llms.txt.

04·CORPUS HUB · HUB.XERJ.ORG

PACKS, SIGNED
AND PINNED.

Signed catalogue
xerj ask reads catalogue.json (ed25519 signature in the sibling .sig). Fetched 2026-10-23: generated_at 2026-10-22T07:11:17Z, format_version 1, 497 corpora, every one with a pack_url. Eleven domains. 490 are adapt-with-attribution and 7 are approach-only. A binary with no hub public key downloads nothing (exit 5). A pack that fails verification exits 3.
The registry page
hub.xerj.org/llms.txt, fetched the same day, lists 514 pinned corpora (514 /corpus/ links in the file, and the opening line says 514). Seventeen of those slugs are not in the signed catalogue: agent-session-trajectories, concourse, counsel-chat, exploit-pocs-2023, exploit-pocs-2024, exploit-pocs-2025, exploit-pocs-2026, exploitdb-src, fluent-bit, freebsd-handbook, ghsa-db, github-api-description, mtl-bioinformatics-ner, nuclei-templates, rust-vulns, xerj-blogposts, xerj-columnar. A registry corpus that is not in the catalogue is added with xerj corpus add and indexed with xerj corpus index.
Contributor index
search/index.json says updated 2026-10-13. Fetched 2026-10-23, p has 4,080 rows (login, name, stars, corpora, kind): 3,663 with kind 0 and a display name, 417 with kind 1 and a blank name. Profiles are at hub.xerj.org/contributors.
Agent scores
Each corpus page keeps an agent score apart from human stars. xerj hub feedback <slug> --usefulness 1-5 --found yes|partial|no and the MCP tool xerj_corpus_feedback send the review. Both are in the rc.98 binary (#1886 merged 2026-10-20). GET /api/corpus-feedback on 2026-10-23 returned prior.mean 3, prior.weight 5, and scores for 3 corpora (awesome-ai-system-prompts, brex-prompt-engineering, prompt-engineering-guide), each score 3.17, reviews 1, confidence “very low”. zstd returned reviews 0 and score null. The Corpus Hub v2 post describes the score as a Bayesian mean with that prior.

06·HOW IT COMPARES

WHAT ELSE
YOU COULD USE.

ToolWhere it is aheadWhere XERJ is ahead
grep / ripgrepNo index, regex, and lower per-call time on a small tree (5 to 7 ms vs 8 to 23 ms on the requests capture)Ranked passages and definitions with file:line. On that capture, 1,303 bytes against 25,150
Zoekt / SourcegraphIdle footprint, and multi-repo fan-out on the 15-repo boardOne binary that also indexes data files and serves MCP, memory and the hub. Definition ranking without ctags
Elasticsearch / OpenSearchRead p99 under a 40k docs/s writer, and the plugin ecosystemNo JVM. The default Linux install is a static musl binary. Agent commands, MCP and the hub are in that binary, on the same wire API. 55 wins on the 88-cell board
A vector databaseA neural index with a model you choose, at a scale you operateBM25, kNN and hybrid in one process. The default embedder needs no API key. Neural mode is a server flag
GitHub code searchEvery public repository, no downloadAn answer from a pinned, signed pack, offline after the first pull, with the licence on the hit

Longer comparisons: XERJ vs ripgrep for code agents, vs Elasticsearch on a laptop, vs a vector database, and all comparisons.

07·FIELD REPORTS

ONE SHORT
REPORT.

xerj feedback drafts a field report and fills in only what it can observe. xerj feedback --submit opens a GitHub pull request that adds one file under user-feedback/16-agent-field-reports/, and posts to xerj.org/api/field-report only when GitHub is unavailable. --disable-feedback or XERJ_DISABLE_FEEDBACK=true turns the invitation off. The same switch turns off corpus-feedback reviews.

On main at this rewrite, that directory holds 52 report files besides the README, dated 2026-08-18 through 2026-10-23.

READ THE REPORTS

08·FAQ

QUESTIONS
PEOPLE ASK.

Is it free?
Yes. The binary and the source are Apache-2.0. There is no email gate. Pricing is for teams that want support.
Does it send my code anywhere?
Indexing and search run on your machine. xerj hub config hosted defaults to auto: off inside a git repository, on elsewhere. --hosted off or --offline keeps the question local. The optional Jev rerank stage is the search-time feature that sends document text off the node, and it stays off until an operator sets a key (llms.txt).
Is search semantic?
Not by default. xerj --help calls the default embedder lexical feature-hash, offline, not neural. --embed-mode neural loads all-MiniLM-L6-v2. proxy points at an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint.
Which agents?
Anything that can run a shell command, and any MCP client. xerj init writes Claude Code, Cursor and Codex config when those directories are present. Other clients use the mcpServers block xerj mcp --help describes.
What platforms?
Linux, macOS and Windows, x86_64 and aarch64: eight targets in the installer. The v1.0.0-rc.98 GitHub release publishes eight archives and two .deb packages, each with a .sha256 file.
Does xerj ask cover any GitHub repo?
No. It answers from the signed catalogue (497 corpora on the 2026-10-23 fetch). Any other repo is a clone plus xerj autoindex. Asking an arbitrary repo URL with no index step is #1800, still open.
